title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Fees and Disbursements
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: Which of the following fee structures is explicitly **prohibited** for a paralegal handling a criminal or quasi-criminal matter (such as a Provincial Offences Act charge)?
options: A contingency fee based on the client being found 'Not Guilty'.
questions.explain: Under the Solicitors Act and Law Society rules governing contingency fees, a legal practitioner is prohibited from entering into a contingency fee agreement for matters that relate to a criminal or quasi-criminal charge (e.g., a POA matter).
